title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer

song.title: Flower in a Hurricane
song.artist: Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard
song.album: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album

official_blurb: Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.
attribution: Stills are official Rockstar press-kit screenshots matched to each beat — not frames from the trailer. © Rockstar Games.

chapters.label: Jason in the Keys
chapters.summary: The trailer opens before anything goes wrong: long-haired Jason working at Brian's Marina in the Leonida Keys, out of the Army on bad terms, unable to get a loan — then a collect call from Lucia in prison.

beats.detail: Road sign opens the trailer; seaplane over the highway, blimp on the horizon.

beats.title: "I got in some trouble in the army"
beats.detail: Jason's voiceover — matches his Rockstar bio. "They don't give loans, anything, to people like me."

chapters.summary: The edit moves into the city: Jason and Lucia together, Vice Beach crowds, a crypto stunt plane, Real Dimez on stage and new road signs that add place names to the map.

chapters.label: Jason's past and the heists
chapters.summary: The action is cut through the middle of the trailer: a night-vision team in the mangroves, a vault full of flying cash, an airport stunt, a helicopter wrecking-ball heist and county sheriffs in pursuit.

chapters.label: The story clues
chapters.summary: Rockstar's new blurb sets the premise — an easy score gone wrong — and the trailer backs it with an ankle monitor, a gold dress seen in all three trailers, and the restated launch date.

beats.title: Ankle monitor
beats.detail: Blinking red in a shower close-up. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson (IGN, Oct 7): the tag is "part of the way we bring Jason and Lucia together".

beats.title: The gold sequin dress
beats.detail: Lucia pulls Jason into a blue-lit club. A similar dress appears in Trailer 1 and Trailer 2.

beats.title: November 19, 2026
beats.detail: End card restates the date — PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
